map.请输入有效参数：风速与叶轮半径须大于 0，空气密度须为正数。: Enter valid parameters: wind speed and rotor radius must exceed 0, and air density must be positive.
map.年发电量按 30% 容量系数估算（实际值取决于风场条件和运维水平）: Annual generation is estimated at a 30% capacity factor (actual value depends on site conditions and O&M).
map.风功率估算（本页代码口径）：扫风面积 A=π×叶轮半径²；理论功率=0.5·ρ·: Wind power estimate (as implemented on this page): swept area A = π × rotor radius²; theoretical power = 0.5·ρ·A·v³ (W); actual power = theoretical × Cp, where Cp takes the input value and is clamped to the 0.593 Betz limit (default 0.4, air density default 1.225 kg/m³); annual generation MWh = actual power kW × 24 × 365 × 30% capacity factor ÷ 1000. Validation: no strict checks; empty values fall back to defaults/0; when v ≤ 0, the rotor area shows "Please enter a valid wind speed". Criteria: no fixed grading; power grows with v³ (doubling wind speed raises power eightfold), and annual generation assumes a 30% capacity factor (noted on the page).
